newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vebacom wants to buy German cable TV group-report.
newsitem.headline: Vebacom wants to buy German cable TV group-report.

text.p: Vebacom GmbH, the German telecommunications joint venture, intends to buy German-based Urbana Telekommunikation in a 500 million mark transaction, Germany's Focus magazine said on Sunday.

The magazine said Vebacom, the joint venture between German energy group Veba AG and Britain's Cable and Wireless, wants to buy Urbana to become the second-largest German cable television operator behind Deutsche Telekom.
Terms of the deal, which must be approved by German authorities, were not disclosed, the magazine said.
A Vebacom spokesman was not available for comment.
Deutsche Telekom, the German national telephone group which was recently privatised, has some 5.5 million cable television connections in the country.
Vebacom, through its Concepta and Telecolumbus units, currently has about 1.2 million connections and would add another 550,000 by acquiring Urbana.
